GET /api/products.description: Products in stock in one UK size, optionally in one category (clothes, swimwear, activewear). With no size, Products in stock in at least one plus size (UK 18+), with size_label and fits null. Every result has in_stock_sizes: its in-stock plus Size labels, UK sizes ascending

GET /api/products/:product_id.description: One Product with all its Size labels

POST /api/click-outs.description: Live check, then { outcome: 'sent', url } or { outcome: 'sold_out', message, similar }

DELETE /api/retailers/:retailer_id.description: Remove a Retailer; its Products leave search at once

GET /api/review.description: The Review list: unsettled Size labels, Products and Suggested Retailers
